snippet.title: Nebulae | Official Trailer | PC Version
snippet.description:
⚡️The Kickstarter preview page is already live.
Hit “Notify Me” 📌now and help us push Nebulae across the finish line!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nothern-lights-ent/nebulae-the-astropolitics-and-startegy-mmo-pc-version?ref=eqwz21 

🌟Nebulae is live on mobile, and now we’re going even further.

Nebulae’s mobile Alpha is already available worldwide, on every Android device!
The success of our first Kickstarter campaign enabled us to patiently test mechanics and systems on mobile and build credibility with our players and smaller gaming investors. But we’ve always wanted Nebulae to be available across mobile and PC. And now, we’re well positioned to take on this challenge, and bring our game to bigger screens, and to more players!
And because Nebulae is a strategy game - the difference in controls between mobile and PC devices is negligible (unlike, say, for shooters)! Remember - our game outcomes are determined by your intelligence, influence and planning, not by the speed of your fingers. (And yes, deceiving your political adversaries in a perfectly executed “long con” is allowed!)
However, a PC screen is still a very comfortable experience for a strategy game - just think about the galaxy map in high-resolution! Playing on a PC through an emulator just creates friction that doesn’t need to be there.
🚀That’s why we’re back on Kickstarter: to expand the galaxy and give Nebulae the home it deserves.
Help us bring our worlds, characters, to an epic scale with the visual quality and sweeping overview that strategy games were made for.
